title: Argentinian Aubergine Skewers with Garlic
description: A flavorful and colorful recipe featuring aubergine, garlic, and a hint of warm spices, inspired by the cuisine of Argentina.

ingredients.name: warmly seasoned salt
ingredients.notes: Combine salt, pepper, and a pinch of paprika

instructions: Thread aubergine and garlic onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with warmly seasoned salt.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
